findings.title: Import of "./index.ts" fails the project's type check
findings.why: tsconfig.json includes `src` and sets `module: NodeNext` with no `allowImportingTsExtensions` or `noEmit`. `tsc` therefore rejects a `.ts` extension in an import path (TS5097), so the type check fails on this test file. The import should be `./index.js`, or the config should be changed to allow `.ts` imports.

findings.title: Plan documents contain only the scaffold placeholder
findings.why: The four plan files (1-2 to 1-5) are marked `status: active` but have an empty `element` and `parent`, and a body that is just the scaffold comment. The comment itself says to replace the placeholders. Task files 002 to 005 also still carry the scaffold comment text.
